title: Ada and the Ember
author: Quentin Thornbury
blurb: Silas Eastwick, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
